description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Fraud' extension controller class for the OpenCart admin panel. It manages listing, installation, and uninstallation of fraud extension modules, with methods for rendering views, handling permissions, and dynamically loading extension data.

classes.name: Fraud
classes.description: Controller class for managing fraud detection extensions within the OpenCart admin panel. Handles listing, installation, and uninstallation of extension modules, with permission checks and dynamic loading of extensions and language data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method that outputs the list of fraud extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML view of the fraud extensions list, including available, installed, and active extensions, with links for installing/uninstalling and editing each extension.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a fraud extension: validating permissions, loading extension files, registering autoloaders, adding permissions, and returning a JSON response.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process for a fraud extension: permission check, invoking model uninstall method, and returning a JSON response.
